name: Data Image Corporation
summary: Data Image Corporation is a specialist in the production and distribution of liquid crystal display (LCD) modules. Its product line encompasses both monochrome and full-color LCD screens. The company supplies these display solutions to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and wholesale partners across a broad spectrum of industries. These applications include industrial human-machine interfaces (HMIs), marine multi-function displays (MFTs), automotive systems, Voice over IP (VoIP) phones, payment terminals, and multi-function printers (MFPs). Established in 1997, Data Image Corporation maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
